directions_tested: plausible tether axes: each of motors 1-6's own pull direction, out and back (12 directions)
source: set_home_pose.py: placed by hand on the real rig, not searched
note: Chosen on the physical arm, with the rig, cables and the other arm in place, rather than from URDF geometry alone. Fourth candidate tried by hand: pose 1 (upright) measured 0.91 mm deviation with 579 ticks of headroom on motor 4; pose 2 (leaned back) 3.12 mm with 277 ticks; pose 3 1.30 mm with 240 ticks; this one improves both at once, 1.19 mm with 417 ticks, which is why it was kept. Re-run scripts/measure_ticks_per_metre.py in this pose before trusting it for ticks_per_metre or yield_sign, since both are pose-dependent.
